task_description: Deep performance optimization for image sequence loading: convert JPGs to WebP, reduce frame count from 300 to 150, implement progressive thumbnail-first loading, make only 1st-vdo block the preloader, and add IntersectionObserver scroll-proximity-based lazy loading for remaining sequences.
